newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala Feb coffee exports 672,982 60-kg bags.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala Feb coffee exports 672,982 60-kg bags.

text.p: Guatemala exported 672,982 60-kg bags of coffee in February, the National Coffee Association (Anacafe) said on Tuesday.
Exports for the month were 41 percent higher than February 1996 exports of 476,080 60-kilo bags, but did not mean increased production, Anacafe president Julio Arrivillaga told Reuters.

Arrivillaga said current high coffee prices on the world market have not benefitted Guatemalan growers because most of the crop had been sold on the futures market before prices rose. Therefore the higher prices would probably not mean expanded production or planting in Guatemala next year, he said.
"There is no capital for planting. The only thing that could happen is growers could fertilize more next year. New planting, I don't see it," he said.

Arrivillaga said total exports for the current harvest, Oct. 1 through Feb. 28 were 2,160,780 60-kg bags. He said Guatemala expects to export at least a million more bags before the end of the harvest in April. Guatemala exported 3.7 million 60-kg bags in the 1995-96 harvest.
February exports were 31 percent higher than in January when 514,269 60-kg bags of coffee were exported.
